convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 moving average indicators (iMA for EMA and WMA). Simple crossover entry/exit logic with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries. No complex money management or multi-timeframe logic.

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal closes current position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: EA uses EMA/WMA crossover strategy. Digit adjustment applied: SL and TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (5-digit broker normalization). Signal reversal logic closes opposite positions before entering new ones. The v2 designation likely indicates refinement over v1 with improved crossover detection using previous bar values ([1]) vs current bar ([0]) to confirm crossover.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use pandas EMA (ewm span=5) and WMA (rolling window=20 with weights). SL/TP must account for 5-digit adjustment: multiply raw pip values by 10 when price has 5 decimal places. New bar detection translates to checking if bar timestamp changed. Position gate check maps to checking if any open position exists before entry. Crossover detection: compare previous bar MA values to confirm cross (EMA[1]>WMA[1] and EMA[2]<=WMA[2] for long).
